meta_desc: Full Porsche service in central Barcelona. More than forty years of experience with classics, youngtimers and current models.
h1: Valentin Motors Barcelona. Porsche specialist workshop since 1979
secciones: Valentin Motors Barcelona. Porsche specialist workshop since 1979
In Barcelona, Valentin Motors is an independent workshop specialising in Porsche, with forty-five years of experience devoted exclusively to the German marque.
At Valentin Motors Barcelona we share your interest in Porsche. Our aim is to extend the working life of your car as far as it will go, and to make sure you get full use of it.
Varsòvia, 65
Our new workshop has more than 1,300 m² given over to specialist Porsche work, plus bodywork and paint. Customer service alongside the Ronda del Mig
Services
Valentin Motors Barcelona offers a complete range of Porsche services:
Servicing: fixed-price servicing is available for several models.
Engine room: specialists in air-cooled classics and in modern engines, to the highest standards.
Restoration: we restore to original Porsche standards and supply the Certificate of Authenticity.
Personalisation: bespoke projects in appearance, finish and performance.
Backdating and restomods: classic looks combined with current technology.
Track preparation: we set your Porsche up for the circuit, whether for the odd session or for club events.
Motorsport: technical support at competitions, with experience going back to 1979.
Track days with the Valentin community: join our own events.
Buying and selling used Porsche: we select and prepare the best cars and offer them at competitive prices with a 12-month warranty.
The Valentin Motors team
Valentin Motors Barcelona has a highly qualified team of two engineers and specialist technicians in engine work, all with extensive Porsche experience.
The team is split into two groups: one dedicated to classics and restoration, the other to youngtimers and more recent Porsche models.
Original parts and leading-brand components

At Valentin Motors Barcelona we work with genuine parts and components from the sector's leading brands. As authorised distributor and installer for TECHART, the German firm, we can vouch for quality and reliability.

Our regular range also includes components from established names: KW and Bilstein suspension, Michelin tyres, AP Racing brakes and clutches, PFC brakes and Heigo roll cages, among other first-rate suppliers. Everything we offer has been tested and assessed by the Valentin Motors team as part of our own research and development.
